This 2220 sq. ft. condo is just steps away from the pool and beach access. You will have access to the infinity-edge Gulf-front pool or the three-tiered pool close to the unit. Relax on your patio or enjoy your spacious living room with breathtaking views of the Gulf of Mexico. This adagio unit comes with two parking spaces.
